ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: the figure is a schematic diagram of a graticule region. The horizontal axis longitude is about 105°E to 120°E, and the vertical axis latitude is about 25°N to 40°N. The region is divided by dashed lines into several subregions ① to ⑥. Area ③ is located in the upper right part of the figure, roughly near 115°E—120°E, 33°N—38°N. Then reason: this longitude-latitude range corresponds to North China, the lower reaches of the Yellow River, and nearby areas in our country. The Yellow River basin, especially the Loess Plateau, has a large amount of incoming sediment, and the rivers in the lower reaches have a high sediment content, so the characteristic of the sediment concentration of the rivers in area ③ is that the sediment concentration is large.
